_comment: Frozen independent drift oracle (PhD-review finding 36). Each value is the ACEF bundle digest (sha256 of the RFC 8785-canonical content-hashes.json) of the same-named golden bundle, recorded once and frozen. The conformance test recomputes it with stdlib hashlib (NOT the SDK's canonicalizer) and compares: any symmetric build+validate canonicalization/hashing drift that the self-referential golden suite would miss changes the recomputed digest and fails against this pin. Do NOT regenerate these values to make a failing test pass — a mismatch means the bundle identity (spec 3.1.1) changed.
